ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across ~85% of the surface with high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily on the distal tips and trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region across the central and basal areas; high-intensity mottling concentrated at the far-left and far-right lateral extremities (distal tips) and as a thin, broken band along the trailing edge serrations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 120-130 degrees and a depth-to-span ratio of roughly 1:15.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge; approximately 18-22 distinct pixel peaks visible on each lobe, with higher amplitude 'steps' appearing on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave-upward curve extending from the median notch to the superiorly-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity (white) circular pixel clusters identified at the far-right distal tip and intermittently along the superior trailing edge margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, ragged tissue loss at the extreme distal tips, particularly the left lobe (viewer perspective), resulting in an asymmetrical, jagged silhouette compared to the smoother basal sections.
